parameters.name: Aggregator
parameters.description: The aggregation method for the metric data. Specify `AVG` to return the average value or `NONE` to return the instantaneous value. The default is `NONE`.

parameters.name: BeginTimestamp
parameters.description: The start of the query time range, as a Unix timestamp in seconds. The total time range must be at least one hour.

parameters.name: EndTimestamp
parameters.description: The end of the query time range, as a Unix timestamp in seconds. This value cannot be in the future.

parameters.name: MaxPointNum
parameters.description: The maximum number of data points to return. The value must be between 5 and 7\**24*\*60. For optimal results, the value should meet the following condition: (time range in minutes) / MaxPointNum > 5.

parameters.name: MetricType
parameters.description:
Specifies the metric to query for the task step. The available options depend on the value of `StepName`.

- For the `FULL_TRANSFER` step, valid metrics are RPS, IOPS, SOURCE\_READ\_TIME, SOURCE\_SLICE\_TIME, and SINK\_EXECUTE\_TIME.

- For the `INCR_TRANSFER` step, valid metrics are DELAY, IOPS, RPS, SINK\_COMMIT\_TIME, and SINK\_EXECUTE\_TIME.

- For the `FULL_VERIFIER` step, valid metrics are FULL\_VERIFY\_SOURCE\_RPS, FULL\_VERIFY\_SOURCE\_READ\_IOPS, FULL\_VERIFY\_DEST\_RPS, and FULL\_VERIFY\_DEST\_READ\_IOPS.

- For the `REVERSE_INCR_TRANSFER` step, valid metrics are RPS, IOPS, DELAY, SINK\_EXECUTE\_TIME, and SINK\_COMMIT\_TIME.

parameters.name: ProjectId
parameters.description: The ID of the data migration or data synchronization project.

parameters.name: StepName
parameters.description: The name of the task step. You can specify one of the following values: `FULL_TRANSFER` for full transfer, `INCR_TRANSFER` for incremental transfer, `FULL_VERIFIER` for full verification, and `REVERSE_INCR_TRANSFER` for reverse incremental transfer.
